summary_1line: Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana travel through the night and cross Kosala’s southern boundary as Ayodhya mourns their exile.

image_candidates.scene_text: The darkened city of Ayodhya sits silent at night, markets empty and lamps unlit as grieving women weep in the streets.
Rama’s chariot pulled by swift horses moves through blossoming fields at dawn as he offers his morning prayer before crossing Kosala’s border.
Villagers along the roadside watch the chariot pass and lament King Dasaratha’s weakness that sent Rama into exile.
